2. PublicationAnalysis_Expert then manually confirmed the authors and checked their publication histories.
3. Verification_Expert verified the findings, confirming the authors and the earliest publication.

The mistake seems to be that the initial search on arXiv was too broad or not targeted, leading to irrelevant results. This mistake was made by AcademicPublication_Expert in step 1, as they didn't find the correct authors and had to switch databases.

So, the agent responsible is AcademicPublication_Expert, who made the mistake at step 1 by conducting an ineffective search on arXiv.
